body:
Closes the limitation named in the previous commit: bare MAGNET is Depth 0 (backward compatible), VectorLit MAGNET (single-state vector before MAGNET) reaches outward by that depth -- reuses MagnetExpr's own already-specified token shape. Emitter names bindings by depth (x0,x1,...), resolves LetRef with a real bounds check. Verified end-to-end: outer/inner bindings XORed together, correct exit code (3). 20 tests total. LO commit 993b0c2.

⚓ ☃
title: LetRef reaches outer Let bindings via a depth index
